description: SALEM, OR – Today, Oregon State Senator David Brock Smith officially launched his campaign for the United States Senate. A third-generation resident of Southwest Oregon and former restaurateur of his family’s built and owned restaurant for 45 years, Smith brings deep roots, real-world experience, and a proven record of results-driven leadership to this campaign for United States Senate.
